_note: Shared seed catalog: rows loaded with org_id = NULL, visible to every firm.
Only fields knowable without a datasheet are filled in. Voc, Isc, temperature
coefficients and dimensions are deliberately absent: they feed string sizing,
where a wrong number oversizes a string and damages an inverter, so they are
left for a human to copy from the manufacturer's sheet and then set
almm_listed and dcr are likewise absent. They must be confirmed against the MNRE
ALMM List-I and the DCR verification portal; until they are, the app treats the
module as ineligible for a subsidy rather than assuming it qualifies.
